content: In order to clean-up the database, the main post-processing step was to filter out problematic utterances. Possible problems include speaker word insertions (e.g. repeating some part of a phrase), deletions, substitutions, and involuntary disfluencies. To detect these, we implemented an alignment stage, similar to the second alignment stage in the LibriSpeech project BIBREF5. In this method, a custom decoding graph was generated for each phrase. The decoding graph allows for word skipping and word insertion in the phrase.
